extracted.intended_audience: journalists, journalism students, journalism educators, newsroom leaders, and members of the public interested in journalism ethics
extracted.subtask_description: An institutional statement of mission, scope, and approach for encouraging and evaluating ethical journalism practice, aimed at practitioners, students, educators and the public. Emphasizes debate, practical application, interdisciplinary insight, recognition of best practice, and accountability for failings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highest standards in journalism ethics
rubrics_metrics.description: Encourage the highest standards in journalism ethics worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Center's mission is to encourage the highest standards, foster vigorous debate about ethical practices, provide resources for producers, consumers and students, and both honor exemplary practice and call attention to journalistic failings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fairness
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursue 'fair ... journalism' as part of the Center's focus on ethics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fairness is presented alongside accuracy and principled conduct as a central aim; the Center examines how professional and personal ethics contribute to fair reporting and decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursue 'accurate ... journalism' as part of the Center's focus on ethics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accuracy is explicitly named as a core dimension of ethical journalism that the Center seeks to promote through research, teaching, debate and newsroom partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principled journalism
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursue 'principled journalism'—conduct guided by ethical principles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Center emphasizes principled practice at both individual and organizational levels, honoring best practices and calling out failings when necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal and organizational ethical practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Emphasize the importance of ethical practice in journalism at both the personal and organizational levels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work and guidance should address practitioner-level decisions as well as institutional policies and culture that affect ethical outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilitate debate and discussion to inform and strengthen professional ethics
rubrics_metrics.description: Facilitate debate and discussion intended to inform and strengthen professional ethics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Center acts as a catalyst for thoughtful discussion, holds conferences, develops advisory boards and awards, and aims to inform and strengthen norms through conversation and public engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical, applied ethics orientation
rubrics_metrics.description: Adopt a practical and interdisciplinary approach: journalism ethics is a branch of professional (applied) ethics addressing issues practitioners face.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance and research should be practitioner-facing and focused on real newsroom dilemmas rather than only abstract theory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interdisciplinary grounding
rubrics_metrics.description: Draw on insights not only from mass communication but from other disciplines (natural and social sciences, philosophy, history).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ethical analysis and recommendations should be informed by empirical research and theoretical perspectives from multiple fields to better serve practitioners and audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognize exemplary practice and hold practitioners accountable
rubrics_metrics.description: Honor the best in ethical journalistic practice and call attention to journalistic failings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Center both recognizes exemplary ethical work (e.g., awards, conferences) and publicly highlights failings, promoting accountability as part of ethical standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serve as a resource for journalists, students and the public
rubrics_metrics.description: Act as a resource on ethical matters for journalists, journalism students and the public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide research, teaching, newsroom partnerships, and accessible materials to support ethical decision-making across audiences.
